scope: Claude design and code integration; all changes local

authentication.primary: Anthropic Console API key, entered through native system dialog; macOS Keychain / Windows Credential Manager
authentication.optional: Existing official ant CLI frameui profile, tokens requested through print-credentials
authentication.browserLogin: Development builds only; CLI not bundled
authentication.workspace: Optional workspace ID for multi-workspace API keys; model list fetched from account

implemented: Main-process Messages API tool loop with cancellation and bounded context
Project source, component intelligence, route, token, asset and font retrieval
Current selection and artboard context plus related project designs
Native editable document operations with component/source/token bindings
Local font byte resolution and source-derived component previews
Reference attachment, project-style default, artboard rendering and bounded pixel comparison
Reviewed source proposals, explicit apply, local checkpoints and guarded undo
Git HEAD/branch guard without automatic commits or pushes
Approved package scripts and managed development process
Activity panel, provider connection, model selection and disconnect

verification.packagedCaptureSuite: passed including direct drag, camera gestures, inline editing and persistence
verification.freshReviewProfile: verified empty, build-specific profile; temporary test profile removed

integrationTestTransport: Deterministic mock Anthropic responses with transient test CLI tokens; real Electron IPC, renderer, component compiler, repository indexing, local runtime capture, file proposal/apply/undo and package command execution.
limitations: No live Anthropic API key or paid Claude request was used; live account verification remains necessary.
Windows native credential storage is implemented but has not been exercised on this macOS machine.
Source-derived component previews can be partial; runtime-dependent components may need an existing capture.
Visual comparison is a bounded viewport pixel comparison, not guaranteed semantic diagnoses of font or layout differences.
Checkpoints snapshot affected files and guard Git HEAD/branch; they do not create Git commits.
